riskAnalysis: This is shared governance, evidence, schema, and scheduling control infrastructure. Credible failures include an executable bypass while W1 is paused, authority-chain rewrite or identity collision, path escape, stale or dirty atomicity failure, self-review, evidence or ledger substitution, an older controller accepting revision 4 state, and review-site flattening. The selected checks therefore cover the complete focused taskctl/planctl/backlog/recovery/view surface, hostile path and identity fixtures, governed quality, exact approved ECR compatibility, generated-page integrity, and clean Git diff hygiene. Product, UI-gate, complete W1, packaging, and release qualification remain outside this bootstrap and are deferred to W1.A03, T03, slice, checkpoint, and Wave exit controls.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A minimal recovery controller validates generic versioned GRR packets, exact independent review, explicit human approval, bounded bootstrap evidence, append-only remediation, and terminal disposition.
evidence: tools/recoveryctl.py implements validate, status, bootstrap-submit, bootstrap-resubmit, bootstrap-review, and release transitions.
tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py and the 103-test focused suite passed.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: The recovery controller semantically binds recovery, hold, target-Wave, base-Wave, consecutive unique predecessor amendment, bootstrap, post-bootstrap ECR/amendment, and proposed-task identity prefixes; structural schema validity alone never authorizes execution.
evidence: tools/recoveryctl.py recovery_identity_errors and validate_authority_chain enforce the cross-field authority identities.
Second/third and mismatched identity fixtures passed in tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Every packet, approval, evidence, ledger, and authorized-scope path is canonical repository-relative POSIX, resolves inside its designated repository directory, and is rejected for absolute, backslash, dot-segment, traversal, redirected-parent, symlink, junction, or other escape behavior.
evidence: safe path controls are enforced in tools/recoveryctl.py, tools/taskctl.py, tools/planctl.py, and tools/plan_review_site.py.
The hostile absolute, backslash, dot-segment, symlink, and simulated junction tests passed.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A controller-enforced hold denies all executable Wave/task/amendment/gate and older-reader paths until exact release conditions are satisfied.
evidence: planning/backlog.yaml records HOLD-W1-GRR-0001 and control revision 4; tools/taskctl.py centrally denies mutation while the hold is active.
Direct Wave resume and revision-3 reader denial tests passed, and taskctl next emits the stopped-recovery handoff.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: ECR validation supports generic subsequent identities and an ordered predecessor authority chain without changing ECR-0001, W1.A01, W1.A02, or their Git objects.
evidence: planning/enabler-change-requests/enabler-change-request.v2.schema.json and tools/planctl.py support generic consecutive ECR/amendment identities.
The exact existing ECR-0001 approved validation passed after the change.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: A compare-and-swap append operation can add a subsequent approved amendment but cannot replace, reorder, duplicate, fork, or silently migrate an existing record.
evidence: tools/taskctl.py implements append-only amendment bootstrap submission with stable identity and history snapshots.
Recovery and amendment history snapshots are prefix-checked by save_validated; the focused taskctl atomicity and predecessor tests passed.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Status and review pages provide a decision-complete stopped-recovery handoff with packet, authority, alternatives, and exact next approval or resume condition.
evidence: tools/taskctl.py renders the decision-complete stopped handoff and tools/plan_review_site.py renders the recovery register/detail and W1 interruption.
tools/plan_review_check.py passed all 147 generated HTML pages.

requiredOutcomes.criterion: Focused tests prove second and third GRR/ECR/amendment identities, cross-field identity binding, stale and dirty denial, self-review denial, predecessor preservation, older-reader denial, and atomic failure behavior.
evidence: tests/foundation/test_recoveryctl.py covers generic identities, mismatches, path attacks, dirty denial, reviewer binding, self-review, older-reader denial, and atomic failed release.
The combined 103-test focused governance suite passed.

This submission is awaiting the required independent control/security disposition; no ECR-0002 files or W1.A03 records exist in the candidate.

The candidate changes no prior approval, amendment packet, adoption evidence, or Git object.

Generic second/third identity and mismatch fixtures passed.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The semantic validator rejects cross-Wave identities, nonconsecutive or duplicate amendment predecessors, mismatched GRR/hold/bootstrap/ECR/task prefixes, and any absolute, backslash, dot-segment, traversal, redirected-parent, symlink, junction, or resolved-path escape.
evidence: tools/recoveryctl.py performs cross-field identity, authority-chain, scope, and resolved-path validation.

evidence: tools/taskctl.py applies a central recovery mutation guard before command dispatch and validates revision 4 control state.
Taskctl validation, resume denial, next-handoff, amendment, gate, schema, and review-page tests passed.

Append-only history and predecessor preservation are enforced by taskctl snapshots and tested in the focused suite.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Bootstrap review and remediation history is append-only and exact-commit bound, and no product or ordinary W1 execution occurs.
evidence: recoveryctl freezes exact commit/evidence/current-submission records and preserves every reviewed attempt as a prefix-checked immutable history.
The exact candidate diff contains only the 29 approved governance/documentation/test/generated paths.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: The repaired ordinary lane can freeze ECR-0002/W1.A03 but GRR-0001 grants zero approval, materialization, activation, claim, execution, adoption, or resume authority to that amendment or its proposed tasks.
evidence: The hold projects execution_authority false and the GRR approval is bootstrap-only.
taskctl permits only the future exact append-bootstrap transition after B00 approval and a separate ECR approval; all other mutations remain denied.
